logs.message: Rune of Unleashed Fire: Procs are assumed to target the same unit that triggered them. Procs triggered by damage are assumed to proc damage. Procs triggered by healing/aura are assumed to proc heal.
Band of the Swarmcaller: Damage is assumed to not be split amongst targets hit.
Enigmatic Dreamwatcher's Lunar Raiment: Damage is assumed to not be split amongst targets hit.
